name: Harikrishna Mekala
about: Senior Software Engineer with over 7 years of experience specializing in the design and development of scalable backend systems, cloud infrastructure, and AI/ML platforms.
Proven expertise in leading modernization projects, migrating legacy systems to cloud-native architectures using Java (Spring Boot), Node.js, and AWS.
Adept at working in fast-paced, Agile environments to deliver high-impact solutions. Feel free to reach out at me@hkmekala.me.

description: Developed key features for Pulse, KeenAi's flagship wealth management product, focusing on backend services and data processing.
Built Vault, a Dropbox-like internal file storage system, to enable secure, efficient, and auditable file management for Family Offices.
Executed a full-stack migration of the backend from Spring Boot (Java) to NestJS (TypeScript), improving system scalability and developer velocity.
Engineered and scaled Large Language Model (LLM) inference and training infrastructure to support high-throughput AI services.
Developed a new platform to integrate Azure OpenAI models, enabling advanced processing of audio, image, and text data.
Significantly enhanced the Data Loss Prevention (DLP) system, strengthening data security and compliance.
Implemented context management and hot-switching capabilities across Gemini, ChatGPT, and Claude models for optimal performance.
Led the reengineering of PayPal Payments settlement infrastructure from on-premises to AWS Cloud, leveraging DynamoDB and EKS for enhanced scalability.
Spearheaded the migration of a legacy C++ codebase to a modern Java SpringBoot framework.
Served as Scrum Master, guiding the team through agile practices to ensure successful project delivery.
Developed services to rank Equity Mutual Funds based on market capitalization and fund allocation percentage.
Added 24 new Indices into Tickertape's universe to help users track diverse market sectors.
Implemented algorithms to calculate PE ratios and volatility for user portfolios with global and sector-based segregation.
Built the highly available Tickertape stock Scorecard API and algorithm, currently serving 4.5 million users.
Added support for regular Mutual Funds, increasing the platform's mutual fund universe by 50%.
Wrote internal gRPC services to scale to millions of requests with efficient LRU cache management.
Led the initiative of migrating Tickertape's legacy API to a new pod-level segregation service using the NestJS framework.
Ensured code quality by performing timely code reviews for peers.
Built a highly available, fault-tolerant content ranking system and provided a REST interface to its algorithms.
Developed a Parsing Engine to scrape RSS feeds of blogs and rank the content within articles.
Established the complete CI/CD flow with SonarQube for automated code reviews and deployments.
Developed an affiliate system to reward users for referrals using PayPal Payout Integration.
Designed an automated firewall-based throttling system to mitigate DDoS attacks by analyzing traffic bursts.
Implemented a queuing mechanism using a manager-worker model to process large sets of content asynchronously.
Set up image delivery through Edge Nodes using KeyCDN and Digital Ocean Spaces.
Gained extensive working experience using Scrum Agile Methodologies.
Designed and implemented a modular, extendable, and easily maintainable Netsuite integration package for Kloudgin FSM.
Built customization to the Kloudgin UI to enable integration between platforms.
Developed a distributed system for migrating large-scale datasets using a multi-threaded library to import customer data to Kloudgin ERP.
Added video streaming support for the crew training and learning module in Kloudgin.
Developed a wrapper for the Java iText Library to facilitate the easy generation of custom invoices in Kloudgin.
Developed an automated Jar deployment plugin for faster deployments of business logic.
Worked on changing the business logic in the Kloudgin backend based on customer tech specifications.
Designed and developed an internal microservices application using Docker for tracking employee billables and biometric data at Infovity.
